newsitem.title: USA: CAI Wireless has $30 mln financing.
newsitem.headline: CAI Wireless has $30 mln financing.

text.p: CAI Wireless Systems Inc said it had signed a letter of intent for up to $30 million in financing, to be used for capital spending associated with the development of the company's MMDS spectrum.
MMDS, or multichannel multipoint distribution services, is a wireless communications technology.
The financing includes a $25 million two-year term loan bearing interest at 13 percent, and a $5 million two-year revolving loan bearing interest at prime plus 4-3/4 percent, the company said.
Lenders will also receive either a convertible note for $1.5 million or $2 million in CAI common stock, CAI said.
The financing will also be used for working capital and general corporate purposes.
